import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.0015, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

H1 = 48
H2 = 32
PROJ = 24
HID = 16
G = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        Z = self.Z
        cin = 8 * Z + 3 + Z
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, H1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(H2, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H2 + Z * H2, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        vox = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        pad = vox.new_zeros(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        padded = torch.cat([pad, vox, pad], 2)
        rel = torch.stack([padded[:, :, z + 1:z + 1 + 2 * Z] for z in range(Z)], 1)
        rel = rel.reshape(B * Z, 8 * Z, Y, X)
        rest = obs[:, 4 * Z:].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, 3, Y, X)
        zoh = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).reshape(1, Z, Z, 1, 1)
        zoh = zoh.expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([rel, rest, zoh], 1)
        f = self.stem(x)
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        s = torch.cat(res, 1)
        T = s.shape[1]
        s = s.reshape(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, 1).flatten(1)
        fg = f.reshape(B, Z, -1, Y, X)
        g_in = torch.cat([fg.mean((1, 3, 4)), fg.amax((1, 3, 4)), fg.amax((3, 4)).flatten(1)], 1)
        g = self.glob(g_in)
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
W = 32
PROJ = 24
HID = 24
DEPTH = 4


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.head = PoolHead(W, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.local = nn.Conv2d(W, len(spec.footprints), 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.stem(obs)
        for c in self.convs:
            f = F.relu(f + c(f))
        place = self.head(f) + self.local(f).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 4, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DCH = 8
DH = 256


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n_cells = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.dproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, DCH, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(DCH * n_cells, DH), nn.ReLU())
        self.dense_out = nn.Linear(DH, spec.n_actions)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64 + DH, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        d = self.dense(F.relu(self.dproj(f)).flatten(1))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + self.dense_out(d)
        value = self.value_head(torch.cat([g, d], dim=1)).squeeze(1)
        return logits, value


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
TH = 8


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.T = len(self.fps)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.square = self.Y == self.X
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, TH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        K = 8 if self.square else 4
        self.final = nn.Conv2d(K * self.T * TH, self.T, 3, padding=1)
        self.act_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(int(spec.n_actions)))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(F.relu(out(h)))
        h = torch.cat(res, 1)
        views = [h, h.flip(2), h.flip(3), h.flip(2, 3)]
        if self.square:
            ht = h.transpose(2, 3)
            views = views + [ht, ht.flip(2), ht.flip(3), ht.flip(2, 3)]
        place = self.final(torch.cat(views, 1)).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1) + self.act_bias
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

C1 = 64
C2 = 32
C3 = 16
HD = 384


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = len(spec.footprints)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = int(spec.in_channels) + self.T
        self.enc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, C1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(C1, C2, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(C2, C3, 3, padding=1), nn.ReLU())
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(C3 * self.Y * self.X, HD), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(HD, HD), nn.ReLU())
        self.pi = nn.Linear(HD, int(spec.n_actions))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pi.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.pi.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(HD, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        f = self.enc(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        h = self.mlp(f.flatten(1))
        return self.pi(h), self.value_head(h).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 32, "n_minibatches": 32, "lr": 0.002, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = len(spec.footprints)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.8, "ent_coef": 0.03}

STEM = 64
COL = 48

PROJ = 32
HID = 32
DONE_OFFSET = 2.0


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) - DONE_OFFSET
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.8, "ent_coef": 0.03}

H1 = 48
H2 = 32
PROJ = 24
HID = 16
G = 64
DONE_OFFSET = 2.0


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        Z = self.Z
        cin = 8 * Z + 3 + Z
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, H1, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(H1, H2, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(H2, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * H2 + Z * H2, G), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(G, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        vox = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        pad = vox.new_zeros(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        padded = torch.cat([pad, vox, pad], 2)
        rel = torch.stack([padded[:, :, z + 1:z + 1 + 2 * Z] for z in range(Z)], 1)
        rel = rel.reshape(B * Z, 8 * Z, Y, X)
        rest = obs[:, 4 * Z:].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, 3, Y, X)
        zoh = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).reshape(1, Z, Z, 1, 1)
        zoh = zoh.expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X).reshape(B * Z, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([rel, rest, zoh], 1)
        f = self.stem(x)
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        s = torch.cat(res, 1)
        T = s.shape[1]
        s = s.reshape(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, 1).flatten(1)
        fg = f.reshape(B, Z, -1, Y, X)
        g_in = torch.cat([fg.mean((1, 3, 4)), fg.amax((1, 3, 4)), fg.amax((3, 4)).flatten(1)], 1)
        g = self.glob(g_in)
        done = self.done_head(g) - DONE_OFFSET
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 3, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.85, "ent_coef": 0.02}

STEM = 64
W = 32
PROJ = 24
HID = 24
DEPTH = 4
DONE_OFFSET = 2.0


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = len(spec.footprints)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(int(spec.in_channels) + self.T, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, W, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(DEPTH)])
        self.head = PoolHead(W, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.local = nn.Conv2d(W, self.T, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.weight)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].reshape(B, self.T, self.Y, self.X).to(obs.dtype)
        f = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], 1))
        for c in self.convs:
            f = F.relu(f + c(f))
        place = self.head(f) + self.local(f).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        done = self.done_head(g) - DONE_OFFSET
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so it never learned to make an exact build within the budget. That leaves two likely causes: too few samples or updates, or a weak prior about where a brick lands. The task depends on layers. A brick's landing layer is the maximum height under its footprint. A good move fills missing target cells at that layer and does not cover missing cells below it. Any tiling counts, because success is judged cell by cell, so good decisions are mostly local to the footprint and the layer. The baseline flattens all layers into channels at the start, so it has to rebuild this from mixed features. I propose a 2x2 design. One candidate keeps the baseline network and changes only the recipe: fewer PPO epochs, so more samples, and a higher lr. Two candidates use a new layer-wise footprint scorer, once with the default recipe and once with the new recipe. Since 0 vs 0 is uninformative, any nonzero result is a signal.
analyses.2: All six training runs scored exactly 0. That covers the baseline and the layer-wise scorer, each with the default recipe and with the 2-epoch, more-samples recipe. Training success was also 0, so the agents never built a design exactly, not even on the training stream. Extra samples did not help, and neither did a strong per-layer prior that assumes the stated layer order and anchor position. Three explanations are still open. (1) Too few policy updates: the default runs make only 32 PPO updates, and the short discount gives little credit for finishing a build. (2) The world may differ from the description, for example in action indexing or anchor alignment, which would break heads that assume the top-left anchor. The note warns about this, and a network with only 1x1 layers, like r1c2, cannot adapt to it. (3) Too little receptive field or depth. This round tests each one: a recipe with many small updates on the unchanged baseline, a deeper residual trunk plus a 3x3 per-type head that does not assume the anchor position, and a dense head that makes no alignment assumption at all.
analyses.3: All 6 trials scored exactly 0 on dev, and also 0 on training success over the last 10% of training. These included recipe changes (more samples, more updates, longer horizon), deeper trunks, a per-layer scorer and a dense head. The baseline head should be able to represent a decent greedy bottom-up policy, so a total failure even on training designs suggests one of two things. Either the world departs from the description in a way that breaks the conv logit alignment (for example a transposed or flipped action index, swapped footprints or a moved DONE index), or learning is far too slow. Seed noise does not matter while everything is 0. Any nonzero score wins, so this round hedges. Candidate 1 is a head that can learn flips, transposes, type swaps, anchor shifts and per-action biases. Candidate 2 is a fully alignment-free dense policy. Candidate 3 is the baseline with the most samples the budget allows. All three feed the legality mask in as input, because it reveals the true action geometry.
analyses.4: Nine trials covering two recipes, two inductive biases (a layer-wise scorer and a deep trunk), two hedges against action misalignment (a dihedral head and a dense MLP) and up to 400k steps all scored exactly 0. Training success in the last 10% was also 0 every time. Seed noise cannot explain that, and neither can a single wrong architecture choice. My best guess is that the agent learns to press DONE immediately. Early random placements earn negative reward, while DONE gives 0 and is always legal. DONE then has a consistently positive advantage, about 0 minus V(s). That advantage grows with gamma, and earlier trials raised gamma to 0.97. A state-independent DONE bias learns much faster than per-cell placement skill. After the collapse, episodes return 0 and the agent never succeeds, which matches what we see. For this last round, all three candidates use the same counter to that collapse: lower gamma and lambda, more entropy bonus, and a DONE logit that starts at zero with a fixed offset of minus 2. I apply it to three different networks (baseline, layer-wise scorer, deep trunk) to maximise the chance that at least one scores above 0.
